title: SURVEY ON ABSTRACTIVE TEXT SUMMARIZATION: DATASET, MODELS, AND METRICS

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the performance of abstractive summarization models fine-tuned on a dataset from one specific domain (e.g., news articles) when tested on documents from different domains to measure the drop in generalization and performance using automatic metrics like ROUGE, METEOR, CHRF, and BertScore.

Evaluating summarization datasets and models for their structural tendency to prioritize information exclusively from specific locations within a document, such as the first paragraph or first sentence of an article, potentially overlooking other relevant information.

Assessing datasets and abstractive summarization models for an over-reliance on copying exact sentences or phrases directly from the source text, which degrades the model's ability to generate diverse and genuinely abstractive summaries.
